580   #=============================================================================
  581   # Attack a single target
  582   #=============================================================================
  583   def pbProcessMoveHit(move, user, targets, hitNum, skipAccuracyCheck)
  584     return false if user.fainted?
  585     # For two-turn attacks being used in a single turn
  586     move.pbInitialEffect(user, targets, hitNum)
  587     numTargets = 0   # Number of targets that are affected by this hit
  588     # Count a hit for Parental Bond (if it applies)
  589     user.effects[PBEffects::ParentalBond] -= 1 if user.effects[PBEffects::ParentalBond] > 0
  590     # Accuracy check (accuracy/evasion calc)
  591     if hitNum == 0 || move.successCheckPerHit?
  592       targets.each do |b|
  593         b.damageState.missed = false
  594         next if b.damageState.unaffected
  595         if pbSuccessCheckPerHit(move, user, b, skipAccuracyCheck)
  596           numTargets += 1
  597         else
  598           b.damageState.missed     = true
  599           b.damageState.unaffected = true
  600         end
  601       end
  602       # If failed against all targets
  603       if targets.length > 0 && numTargets == 0 && !move.worksWithNoTargets?
  604         targets.each do |b|
  605           next if !b.damageState.missed || b.damageState.magicCoat
  606           pbMissMessage(move, user, b)
  607           if user.itemActive?
  608             Battle::ItemEffects.triggerOnMissingTarget(user.item, user, b, move, hitNum, @battle)
  609           end
  610           break if move.pbRepeatHit?   # Dragon Darts only shows one failure message
  611         end
  612         move.pbCrashDamage(user)
  613         user.pbItemHPHealCheck
  614         pbCancelMoves
  615         return false
  616       end
  617     end
  618     # If we get here, this hit will happen and do something
  619     all_targets = targets
  620     targets = move.pbDesignateTargetsForHit(targets, hitNum)   # For Dragon Darts
  621     targets.each { |b| b.damageState.resetPerHit }
  622     #---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  623     # Calculate damage to deal
  624     if move.pbDamagingMove?
  625       targets.each do |b|
  626         next if b.damageState.unaffected
  627         # Check whether Substitute/Disguise will absorb the damage
  628         move.pbCheckDamageAbsorption(user, b)
  629         # Calculate the damage against b
  630         # pbCalcDamage shows the "eat berry" animation for SE-weakening
  631         # berries, although the message about it comes after the additional
  632         # effect below
  633         move.pbCalcDamage(user, b, targets.length)   # Stored in damageState.calcDamage
  634         # Lessen damage dealt because of False Swipe/Endure/etc.
  635         move.pbReduceDamage(user, b)   # Stored in damageState.hpLost
  636       end
  637     end
  638     # Show move animation (for this hit)
  639     move.pbShowAnimation(move.id, user, targets, hitNum)
  640     # Type-boosting Gem consume animation/message
  641     if user.effects[PBEffects::GemConsumed] && hitNum == 0
  642       # NOTE: The consume animation and message for Gems are shown now, but the
  643       #       actual removal of the item happens in def pbEffectsAfterMove.
  644       @battle.pbCommonAnimation("UseItem", user)
  645       @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("The {1} strengthened {2}'s power!",
  646                               GameData::Item.get(user.effects[PBEffects::GemConsumed]).name, move.name))
  647     end
  648     # Messages about missed target(s) (relevant for multi-target moves only)
  649     if !move.pbRepeatHit?
  650       targets.each do |b|
  651         next if !b.damageState.missed
  652         pbMissMessage(move, user, b)
  653         if user.itemActive?
  654           Battle::ItemEffects.triggerOnMissingTarget(user.item, user, b, move, hitNum, @battle)
  655         end
  656       end
  657     end
  658     # Deal the damage (to all allies first simultaneously, then all foes
  659     # simultaneously)
  660     if move.pbDamagingMove?
  661       # This just changes the HP amounts and does nothing else
  662       targets.each { |b| move.pbInflictHPDamage(b) if !b.damageState.unaffected }
  663       # Animate the hit flashing and HP bar changes
  664       move.pbAnimateHitAndHPLost(user, targets)
  665     end
  666     # Self-Destruct/Explosion's damaging and fainting of user
  667     move.pbSelfKO(user) if hitNum == 0
  668     user.pbFaint if user.fainted?
  669     if move.pbDamagingMove?
  670       targets.each do |b|
  671         next if b.damageState.unaffected
  672         # NOTE: This method is also used for the OHKO special message.
  673         move.pbHitEffectivenessMessages(user, b, targets.length)
  674         # Record data about the hit for various effects' purposes
  675         move.pbRecordDamageLost(user, b)
  676       end
  677       # Close Combat/Superpower's stat-lowering, Flame Burst's splash damage,
  678       # and Incinerate's berry destruction
  679       targets.each do |b|
  680         next if b.damageState.unaffected
  681         move.pbEffectWhenDealingDamage(user, b)
  682       end
  683       # Ability/item effects such as Static/Rocky Helmet, and Grudge, etc.
  684       targets.each do |b|
  685         next if b.damageState.unaffected
  686         pbEffectsOnMakingHit(move, user, b)
  687       end
  688       # Disguise/Endure/Sturdy/Focus Sash/Focus Band messages
  689       targets.each do |b|
  690         next if b.damageState.unaffected
  691         move.pbEndureKOMessage(b)
  692       end
  693       # HP-healing held items (checks all battlers rather than just targets
  694       # because Flame Burst's splash damage affects non-targets)
  695       @battle.pbPriority(true).each do |b|
  696         next if move.preventsBattlerConsumingHealingBerry?(b, targets)
  697         b.pbItemHPHealCheck
  698       end
  699       # Animate battlers fainting (checks all battlers rather than just targets
  700       # because Flame Burst's splash damage affects non-targets)
  701       @battle.pbPriority(true).each { |b| b.pbFaint if b&.fainted? }
  702     end
  703     @battle.pbJudgeCheckpoint(user, move)
  704     # Main effect (recoil/drain, etc.)
  705     targets.each do |b|
  706       next if b.damageState.unaffected
  707       move.pbEffectAgainstTarget(user, b)
  708     end
  709     move.pbEffectGeneral(user)
  710     targets.each { |b| b.pbFaint if b&.fainted? }
  711     user.pbFaint if user.fainted?
  712     # Additional effect
  713     if !user.hasActiveAbility?(:SHEERFORCE)
  714       targets.each do |b|
  715         next if b.damageState.calcDamage == 0
  716         chance = move.pbAdditionalEffectChance(user, b)
  717         next if chance <= 0
  718         move.pbAdditionalEffect(user, b) if @battle.pbRandom(100) < chance
  719       end
  720     end
  721     # Make the target flinch (because of an item/ability)
  722     targets.each do |b|
  723       next if b.fainted?
  724       next if b.damageState.calcDamage == 0 || b.damageState.substitute
  725       chance = move.pbFlinchChance(user, b)
  726       next if chance <= 0
  727       if @battle.pbRandom(100) < chance
  728         PBDebug.log("[Item/ability triggered] #{user.pbThis}'s King's Rock/Razor Fang or Stench")
  729         b.pbFlinch(user)
  730       end
  731     end
  732     # Message for and consuming of type-weakening berries
  733     # NOTE: The "consume held item" animation for type-weakening berries occurs
  734     #       during pbCalcDamage above (before the move's animation), but the
  735     #       message about it only shows here.
  736     targets.each do |b|
  737       next if b.damageState.unaffected
  738       next if !b.damageState.berryWeakened
  739       @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("The {1} weakened the damage to {2}!", b.itemName, b.pbThis(true)))
  740       b.pbConsumeItem
  741     end
  742     # Steam Engine (goes here because it should be after stat changes caused by
  743     # the move)
  744     if [:FIRE, :WATER].include?(move.calcType)
  745       targets.each do |b|
  746         next if b.damageState.unaffected
  747         next if b.damageState.calcDamage == 0 || b.damageState.substitute
  748         next if !b.hasActiveAbility?(:STEAMENGINE)
  749         b.pbRaiseStatStageByAbility(:SPEED, 6, b) if b.pbCanRaiseStatStage?(:SPEED, b)
  750       end
  751     end
  752     # Fainting
  753     targets.each { |b| b.pbFaint if b&.fainted? }
  754     user.pbFaint if user.fainted?
  755     # Dragon Darts' second half of attack
  756     if move.pbRepeatHit? && hitNum == 0 &&
  757        targets.any? { |b| !b.fainted? && !b.damageState.unaffected }
  758       pbProcessMoveHit(move, user, all_targets, 1, skipAccuracyCheck)
  759     end
  760     return true
  761   end
  762 end
